tables.title: Bayesian One Sample T-Test
notes: Prior: Cauchy on effect size δ with scale r = 0.707.

interpretation.text:
A Bayesian One Sample T-Test used a Cauchy prior with scale r = 0.707 on the standardized effect size.

For mpg, the data are 5.28 times more likely under H₀ (the mean equals 20.00) than under H₁ (the mean differs from 20.00): BF₁₀ = 0.189, moderate evidence for H₀. The posterior median effect size is δ = 0.01, 95% credible interval [−0.31, 0.33].

title: Bayesian One Sample T-Test
code:
library(BayesFactor)
library(ggnext)
# Bayesian one sample t-test: mpg against 20 (tested as x - test value against 0, so the posterior delta is relative to the test value)
d <- subset(data, !is.na(mpg))
desc <- data.frame(variable = "mpg", n = nrow(d), mean = mean(d$mpg), sd = sd(d$mpg))
rscale <- sqrt(2) / 2   # Cauchy prior width on the effect size delta
bf <- ttestBF(x = d$mpg - 20, rscale = rscale)
bf10 <- extractBF(bf)$bf
set.seed(123)
delta <- as.numeric(posterior(bf, iterations = 10000, progress = FALSE)[, "delta"])
# Prior and posterior density of delta
grid <- seq(min(-2, quantile(delta, 0.001)), max(2, quantile(delta, 0.999)), length.out = 400)
dens <- density(delta)
pp <- rbind(
  data.frame(delta = grid, density = approx(dens$x, dens$y, grid, yleft = 0, yright = 0)$y, Distribution = "Posterior"),
  data.frame(delta = grid, density = dcauchy(grid, 0, rscale), Distribution = "Prior"))
p_pp <- ggnext(pp, aes(delta, density, color = Distribution)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Prior and posterior: mpg", x = "Effect size (δ)", y = "Density") +
  theme_modern()
# Robustness check: the Bayes factor across prior widths
rob <- data.frame(r = seq(0.05, 1.5, by = 0.05))
rob$bf10 <- sapply(rob$r, function(r) extractBF(ttestBF(x = d$mpg - 20, rscale = r))$bf[1])
rob_user <- data.frame(r = rscale, bf10 = bf10)
p_rob <- ggnext(rob, aes(r, log10(bf10))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = rob_user, size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, dash = "4 4") +
  labs(title = "Bayes factor robustness: mpg", x = "Prior width (r)", y = "log10(BF₁₀)") +
  theme_modern()
